name: list
description:
Which LXC containers on the Proxmox hosts have services running outdated libraries?

For every selected host a table shows the containers, their state (clean / restart / CVEs) and the affected services with CVE verdicts. Rows with work to do deep-link into the **restart** runner with host and container pre-filled (the Action there keeps its default, restart).

- **All hosts** (checkbox) runs the report on every host that has needrestart-lxc deployed - no need to pick hosts in the pulldown. When it is ticked the Hosts selection is ignored.
- Without the checkbox, pick one or more hosts in the **Hosts** pulldown.
- **Scan now** runs a fresh scan on each host (a few seconds; also warms the hosts' 24h CVE cache). This is the default.
- **Cached** reads the JSON the hosts' 15-minute cron generates (instant, up to 15 minutes old).

parameters.name: All hosts
parameters.description: Tick to report on ALL hosts with needrestart-lxc deployed. Overrides the Hosts selection (which may then stay empty).

parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: Proxmox hosts to report on (distro explorer == proxmox). May stay empty when 'All hosts' is ticked.

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: Fresh scan on the hosts, or read their cached Zabbix JSON.
